site: boosterpack (site 1, J1 to J4); checked by the pin scan 2026-10-20

adc.simultaneous: the three currents share ADC0, so they sample in turn; one current on ADC1 would need a wire

protect.nfault_to_timer_fault: no (PB30 has no timer fault function); a wire to PA1, PA13, PA29, PB8, PB24, PC2 or PC20 would give one
protect.ilimit: PC2 has no DAC; driven to 3.3 V, the driver's cycle-by-cycle limit is off
protect.software: phase current, bus window and stall checked every PWM period; nFAULT on a top-priority GPIO interrupt sets DRVOFF high in 0.97 to 1.31 us at 32 MHz (fault-and-sweep-20261020.md)

console: none: Halls sit on the backchannel UART pins; results in RAM over the probe
